messages:
maria: Heads-up — preparing joint perf/W + throughput bench with NovaChip for marketplace listing. Want to lock down runbook, telemetry contract, and announcement windows. Tentative public date 2 weeks after lab run. Can the HW team confirm kernel tuning window and whether we can surface fixed test harness in marketplace images? :eyes:

sunil: thanks. we can do kernel tuning next Tue-Thu. need ABI for driver patching. we'll request dev-swap builds. will share patch id. also: thermal headroom tests require fan-curves from partner.

elaine: for announcement we need consistent numbers: baseline (stock), tuned (our kernels+quant). define metrics: tokens/sec @ 512, avg watt @ 99th percentile, perf/W at sustained 90s. Also need error bars and prompt set.

jordan: I can own the runbook + gitops. I'll create a branch in infra-bench repo with steps, docker image tags, and a telemetry schema. will include rng seeds and prompt list. link when ready.

maria: perfect. can we add a gating metric: tuned perf/W >= 1.15x over baseline and latency 95th <= 200ms for 512 tokens? if not met, hold announcement.

sunil: ack on gates. FYI kernels may increase tail-latency slightly; we'll measure. patch flow: partner provides firmware + driver; we apply Kconfig flags: CONFIG_PREEMPT=y, LL_KERNEL_BATCHING=1.

jordan: created branch: https://git.redwood/infra-bench/novachip-partner-bench/tree/announce-runbook — contains steps and `bench.yaml`. benchbot just queued the first dry-run: job/5721.

benchbot: job 5721 queued by jordan — dry-run scheduled on lab-cluster-4. Estimated runtime 4h. Artifacts will appear in /bench/artifacts/5721.

sunil: started kernel build + flash, logs look clean. snippet: ```[OK] modules: novadrv v1.2.4 loaded
[WARN] thermal: falling back to conservative curve```

elaine: for marketplace listing we'll need a blurb + approved screenshots. marketing wants a short technical blurb and a non-technical highlight. @maria can you draft the tech blurb after we have final numbers? aim to freeze copy 24h before announcement.

maria: yes — i'll draft. also need partner signoff for logo + quote. can product ops send NDA/approval link?

jordan: dry-run completed. artifacts: perf.csv, power.csv, latency.json. benchbot uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood/5721. Preliminary: perf/W tuned = 1.18x baseline, 95th latency = 190ms at 512. Sharing details in the branch.

maria: wow nice. can we add an explicit note about telemetry retention (30 days) and PII scrubbed? we must not store any customer prompts.

sunil: confirmed telemetry is aggregated — raw prompts are hashed client-side. partner accepted. we'll schedule full sweep next week and then freeze figures.

elaine: good. I'll loop marketing and legal. next milestone: full sweep finish + partner signoff -> freeze copy -> announce. timeline in runbook.

maria: thanks team — next: jordan, leave the runbook PR open until post-announcement for audit trail. sunil please post the final kernel patch id in the PR. :thumbsup:
